'''Greik''' was an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. Around [[3670 BBY]], after the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Third battle of the Seswenna sector|victory]] in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]], Greik caught wind of an Imperial plan to attack the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. In an effort to outmaneuver the Republic's foes, Greik proposed the risky tactic of amassing the entirety of the Republic Navy above the world. The decision proved to be a prudent one, and when the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy's]] strike fleet attacked Bothawui, all of the Sith's ships were destroyed with minimal Republic casualties.
